name: Meredith Grey
role: General Surgeon → Chief of General Surgery
bio: Daughter of the legendary Ellis Grey. Stumbled out of a one-night stand on day one of her intern year and into the orbit of the show's central love story. Survived a bomb, a drowning, a hospital shooting, a plane crash, and COVID; lost her husband, her sister, two best friends, and her mother along the way. Won the Catherine Fox Award and moved most of her practice to Boston in 2023, but still pops in to Grey Sloan.

soloEvents.label: First day as an intern at Seattle Grace Hospital
Reaches into a body cavity to defuse a bomb
Pulled lifeless from Elliott Bay after the ferry boat crash; revived
Shot in the abdomen during the hospital shooting; loses a pregnancy
Earns her board certification; adopts Zola
Survives the plane crash that kills Lexie and Mark
Gives birth to daughter Ellis on her bathroom floor during a citywide blackout
Widowed when Derek is killed in a car accident
Wins the Harper Avery Award (later renamed the Catherine Fox Award)
Convicted of insurance fraud for treating an undocumented child under Bailey's daughter's name; loses her medical license briefly
Contracts COVID-19; spends much of S17 in a beach-coma dreamscape
Moves most of her work to a Parkinson's research lab in Boston

name: Derek Shepherd
role: Head of Neurosurgery → Chief of Surgery
bio: McDreamy. World-class neurosurgeon from a big Catholic family in Connecticut, on the run from a failing marriage to Addison when he met an intern named Meredith Grey at Joe's bar. Briefly Chief of Surgery; later helped lead the federal brain-mapping initiative. Died in 2015 after stopping to help at a roadside accident and being struck by a semi.

soloEvents.label: Arrives at Seattle Grace as the new attending neurosurgeon
Loses a patient on the operating table; spirals into a brief depression in his trailer
Operates on Izzie's brain tumor; later named Chief of Surgery
Plane crash; severe hand injury threatens his career
Takes a presidential brain-mapping job in D.C.; commutes
Killed in a car accident en route to the airport

name: Cristina Yang
bio: Brilliant, prickly, competitive cardiothoracic prodigy who became Meredith's 'person.' Engaged to her mentor Preston Burke (who left her at the altar), later married to Owen Hunt (which ended over her refusal to have children). Survived the shooting, the plane crash, and a near-fatal car bombing in Sudan. Took over Burke's research institute in Zurich in 2014 and left for good.

soloEvents.label: Begins her intern year at Seattle Grace
Operates at gunpoint during the hospital shooting
Has an abortion in S8 over Owen's objections
Survives the plane crash with PTSD
Inherits Preston Burke's Zurich institute and leaves Seattle for good

name: Alex Karev
role: Pediatric Surgeon → Chief of Pediatric Surgery → Interim Chief
bio: Started as the show's loudmouth bully and ended as one of its most quietly loyal characters — Meredith's actual 'person' in Cristina's absence. Pediatric surgeon, briefly Chief of Surgery, husband (twice). Left in 2020 via a letter, having reunited with Izzie Stevens in Kansas and the twins he never knew he had.

soloEvents.label: Begins his intern year, arrogant and pre-bruised
Pulls 'Ava' (Rebecca Pope) from the ferry-boat wreckage
Shot in the chest by the hospital shooter; survives
Beats Andrew DeLuca nearly to death; faces felony charges and a plea deal
Named interim Chief of Surgery when Bailey takes leave
Disappears from Seattle; reveals via letters that he reunited with Izzie and their twins in Kansas

name: Izzie Stevens
bio: Former teen-mom-turned-Mercy-West-intern who put herself through Mount Sinai with underwear modeling. Fell for a patient (Denny Duquette), cut his LVAD wire, and lost him anyway. Diagnosed with Stage IV melanoma in 2008; married Alex Karev from a hospital bed during chemo. Walked away in 2010 after he refused to take her back. Later revealed to be living in Kansas with twins fathered by Alex from frozen embryos.

soloEvents.label: Diagnosed with Stage IV melanoma; the tumor has metastasized to her brain
Marries Alex in a borrowed wedding from a deathbed scene
Leaves Seattle when Alex refuses to take her back
Revealed (off-screen) to be a surgical oncologist in Kansas raising her twins with Alex

name: George O'Malley
bio: Bambi. The sweet, stuttering intern with a crush on Meredith who became the unlikely heart of the original group. Failed his intern exam, repeated the year, then enlisted in the Army. Killed in 2009 saving a woman from being hit by a bus; arrived at Seattle Grace as 'John Doe' so disfigured no one recognized him until he traced '007' on Meredith's palm.

soloEvents.label: Begins his intern year alongside Meredith, Cristina, Izzie, and Alex
Fails his intern exam and has to repeat the year
Enlists in the U.S. Army as a trauma surgeon
Killed pushing a woman out of the path of a bus; identified as 'John Doe' only when he traces '007' into Meredith's hand

name: Miranda Bailey
bio: The Nazi (her interns' name, not hers). The institutional spine of Grey Sloan. Tough, terrifying, tender — she's been the residents' mom and the show's moral compass for two decades. Twice-married (Tucker, then Ben), mother of Tuck Jr. and William; survived a heart attack in 2018, an OCD diagnosis the same year, and the death of basically everyone she trained.

soloEvents.label: Gives birth to Tuck during the ferry boat crisis while Tucker is in critical surgery
Named general surgery chief; later promoted up the chain
Named Chief of Surgery, replacing Owen Hunt
Suffers a heart attack at a rival hospital that initially dismisses her symptoms
Diagnosed with OCD
Threatens to quit and reboot the residency program after the program is suspended

name: Richard Webber
role: Chief of Surgery → General Surgery Attending → Director of Residency
bio: The institutional father of Grey Sloan. Mentored Ellis Grey (and slept with her), then mentored her daughter. Recovering alcoholic — relapsed memorably in 2015 and again in 2020. Widowed when Adele died in 2013; later married Catherine Avery. Survived a near-fatal electrocution in 2018 and a misdiagnosed Parkinson's-then-cobalt-poisoning storyline in 2019.

soloEvents.label: Falls off the wagon after Adele finds out about Ellis; goes to AA
Adele dies of complications from Alzheimer's after Bailey's surgery
Electrocuted in surgery; nearly dies
Misdiagnosed with Parkinson's; the cause is cobalt poisoning from a hip replacement

name: Preston Burke
bio: Cardio prodigy. Cristina's mentor and fiancé. Shot by a bystander in S2 — the nerve damage threatened to end his career. Left Cristina at the altar in 2007 and vanished from the show. Returned briefly in 2014 to hand over his Zurich research institute to Cristina.

soloEvents.label: Shot by a man searching for his missing wife; suffers nerve damage in his hand
Leaves Cristina at the altar in their over-the-top wedding
Returns to offer Cristina his Zurich institute

name: Addison Montgomery
role: Head of Neonatal Surgery / OB-GYN / Reproductive Endocrinology
bio: Walked into the S1 finale as 'the wife you didn't mention,' walked out of the show in 2007 to launch her own (Private Practice). World-class neonatal and fetal surgeon. Returned to Grey Sloan as a recurring guest from 2021 onward — first to help Meredith's research, then to fight an abortion-rights storyline.
note: Left Grey's Anatomy in 2007 as the lead of the spin-off Private Practice (which ran 2007–2013). Returned to Grey's as a recurring guest from S18 onward.

soloEvents.label: Arrives at Seattle Grace as Derek's still-married wife
Moves to Los Angeles to join Oceanside Wellness
Returns to Grey Sloan to consult on Meredith's research

name: Mark Sloan
bio: McSteamy. Manhattan plastic surgeon who slept with his best friend's wife (Addison) and then followed him to Seattle. Co-parented Sofia with Callie and Arizona. Loved Lexie Grey almost from the start and finally got to say so seconds before she died in the plane crash. Survived the crash himself, briefly came back from the brink, then died days later.

soloEvents.label: Arrives in Seattle following Addison
Discovers he has a teenage daughter, Sloan Riley
Co-parents Sofia Robbin Sloan Torres with Callie and Arizona
Survives the plane crash with critical injuries
Dies thirty days later after a brief, false recovery

name: Callie Torres
bio: Daughter of a wealthy Catholic Cuban-American family. Orthopedic surgeon, briefly Chief Resident's pet project, then department head. Married George O'Malley (brief, doomed). Came out as bisexual via Erica Hahn, then fell in love with Arizona Robbins; they married, had Sofia, divorced. Left Seattle in 2016 for New York with Penny Blake.

soloEvents.label: Comes out via her relationship with Erica Hahn
Estranged from her Catholic father after coming out as bisexual
Nearly dies in a car crash; Sofia born premature in emergency surgery
Moves to New York with Penny Blake; takes Sofia after a brutal custody fight

name: Arizona Robbins
role: Head of Pediatric Surgery / Fetal Surgery
bio: Named after the battleship her father served on (her brother was Tim). Pediatric surgery prodigy with a perky exterior and a steel-spined center. Married Callie, had Sofia, lost her leg in the plane crash, had an affair, watched her marriage end. Trained in fetal surgery under Nicole Herman. Left Grey Sloan in 2018 to move to New York and be close to Sofia.

soloEvents.label: Targeted by the hospital shooter; ducks into a bathroom and survives
Plane crash; left leg amputated above the knee against her wishes
Becomes a board-certified fetal surgeon after training under Nicole Herman
Leaves for New York to be near Sofia after Callie wins custody

name: Lexie Grey
bio: Meredith's half-sister, Thatcher and Susan's daughter. Photographic memory, painful earnestness, and an unrequited and then very-requited love story with Mark Sloan. Killed in the plane crash in 2012, pinned beneath wreckage, holding Mark's hand while he finally told her 'meant to be.'

soloEvents.label: Susan, her mother, dies; her father Thatcher relapses
Joins Seattle Grace as an intern and meets Meredith for the first time
Talks down the hospital shooter and survives
Killed in the plane crash; Mark says 'meant to be' as she dies

name: Jackson Avery
bio: Grandson of Harper Avery (the surgical award namesake), son of Catherine Fox — wealth and surgical royalty he tried very hard not to use. Plastic surgeon, briefly Chief of Plastics, Board chair after the Foundation bought Grey Sloan. Married April Kepner (then divorced); fathered Harriet. Left in 2021 to run the Foundation from Boston with Jackson's daughter and the (eventually re-coupled) April.

soloEvents.label: Transfers to Seattle Grace from Mercy West in the hospital merger
Plane crash; one of the few uninjured
Father Robert Avery reappears in Jackson's life briefly
Wins the Harper Avery Award (it's then renamed in his late grandfather's place)
Moves to Boston to run the Catherine Fox Foundation

name: April Kepner
bio: Devout evangelical farm girl from Ohio who joined from Mercy West and became Grey Sloan's trauma surgeon. Twice-married to Jackson (once jilted Matthew Taylor at the altar to elope); mother of Harriet (and Samuel, who was born with skeletal dysplasia and lived only hours). Lost and re-found her faith in 2017. Left Grey Sloan in 2018 to do trauma work in the field and remarry Matthew.

soloEvents.label: Transfers from Mercy West in the merger
Survives the hospital shooting; watches Reed Adamson die in front of her
Gives birth to son Samuel, who lives only hours due to osteogenesis imperfecta
Loses her faith after a series of patient losses; restored later in the season
Leaves Grey Sloan for trauma fieldwork; re-marries Matthew Taylor

name: Owen Hunt
role: Head of Trauma → Chief of Surgery
bio: Iraq-war army trauma surgeon with severe PTSD. Briefly tried to strangle Cristina in his sleep; spent the next decade trying to be worthy of someone. Two failed marriages to Cristina and Amelia. Long-time on-and-off relationship with Teddy that finally landed. Sister Megan presumed dead in Iraq for ten years, then alive. Two kids with Teddy (Leo adopted, Allison biological). Left Grey Sloan in 2026 with Teddy and the kids for her new job in Paris.

soloEvents.label: Arrives in Seattle from Iraq; severe PTSD
Reunites with sister Megan after she had been presumed dead for a decade
Adopts Leo (formerly Bailey-Jr.-of-Betty)
Survives a helicopter crash and a near-amputation
Single-handedly rescues the Greene family — Sam, Josh, Hank, and Laney — from a collapsing Seattle bridge, performing a field cricothyrotomy and a field amputation
Leaves Grey Sloan for Paris with Teddy and their kids

name: Teddy Altman
role: Head of Cardiothoracic Surgery → Chief of Surgery
bio: Army cardiothoracic surgeon who served with Owen in Iraq and had loved him since. Married a patient (Henry Burton) so he could get insurance — and then fell in love with him; lost him on the table. Took a five-year hiatus; returned in 2018 pregnant with Owen's daughter, Allison. Became Chief of Surgery in 2019. Left Grey Sloan in 2026 for a job opportunity in Paris, with Owen and the kids in tow.

soloEvents.label: Arrives at Seattle Grace as the new head of cardio at Owen's request
Henry Burton dies on her operating table; she leaves Seattle
Gives birth to Allison Hunt on the bathroom floor of a hotel room
Named Chief of Surgery
Suffers a heart attack; later resigns as Chief after the hospital fire scandal
Activates Grey Sloan's full disaster response after the Royer Bridge collapse — and learns Owen was on it
Takes a cardiothoracic position in Paris; leaves Grey Sloan with Owen and the kids

name: Catherine Fox
role: Urologist / Board Chair of the Catherine Fox Foundation
bio: Renowned urologist, daughter-in-law of Harper Avery, mother of Jackson, and (eventually) wife of Richard Webber. Owns Grey Sloan via the Foundation she renamed after herself in 2018. Survived a rare chordoma cancer in 2020. Often the show's vehicle for institutional politics and Black-feminist commentary.

soloEvents.label: First introduced as an attending consult; mother of Jackson
Marries Richard Webber
Renames the Harper Avery Foundation the 'Catherine Fox Foundation' after the sexual-harassment scandal
Diagnosed with chordoma; undergoes surgery; survives

name: Ben Warren
role: Anesthesiologist → Surgical Resident → Firefighter (Station 19) → Surgical Attending
bio: Started as an anesthesiologist Bailey was dating, restarted as a surgical resident (with Bailey as his boss), then quit medicine for the Seattle Fire Department's Station 19. Married Bailey. Stepfather to Tuck, father to William. Returned to Grey Sloan as a surgical attending after Station 19 wrapped.
note: Crossed over to lead Station 19 (2018–2024); returned to Grey's Anatomy as a main cast member when Station 19 ended.

soloEvents.label: First appears as the anesthesiologist Bailey starts dating
Quits anesthesia to restart as a surgical resident under his own wife
Leaves surgery to become a firefighter at Station 19
Returns to Grey Sloan as a surgical attending

name: Amelia Shepherd
bio: Derek's youngest sister. Recovering addict (heroin, opioids, alcohol) who watched her father die when she was five. Took over Derek's department after he died. Carried a baby with anencephaly to term so the organs could be donated (2014). Married Owen Hunt (divorced). Has a son Scout with Link. Discovered in 2017 that a massive 'brain tumor' was the source of years of bad decisions; survived its removal.
note: Originally introduced on Private Practice (2011–2013) before joining Grey's full-time in 2014.

soloEvents.label: Carries a baby with anencephaly to term to donate his organs; names him Christopher
Takes over Derek's neurosurgery department after his death
Diagnosed with a 10-cm meningioma; survives its removal
Gives birth to son Scout, fathered by Link
Tangled in a brief affair with plastic surgeon Toni Wright; ends when Toni catches Amelia entertaining trauma surgeon Cass Beckman

name: Maggie Pierce
bio: Cardio prodigy who arrived at Grey Sloan in 2014 to discover she was Ellis Grey and Richard Webber's biological daughter — making her Meredith's half-sister. Quietly steady through years of chaos. Married Winston Ndugu in 2021; divorced him in 2023 and moved to Chicago.

soloEvents.label: Arrives in Seattle to take over cardio; reveals she's Ellis Grey's biological daughter
Mother Diane Pierce dies of inflammatory breast cancer
Divorces Winston and leaves Grey Sloan for Chicago

name: Jo Wilson
bio: Born in a Pittsburgh fire-station bathroom (her real name is Brooke Stadler); abandoned, foster-raised, abusive first marriage. Hid out at Seattle Grace under the name 'Jo Wilson.' Married Alex Karev, divorced him by letter when he left for Izzie. Pivoted from general surgery to OB-GYN after the trauma of Karev. Adopted Luna as a single mom; now in a relationship with Link.

soloEvents.label: Joins Grey Sloan as an intern using the alias 'Jo Wilson'
Reveals to Alex that she's still legally married to her abusive first husband, Paul Stadler
Paul Stadler dies in a hit-and-run; Jo is finally free
Receives Alex's letters; he leaves her for Izzie
Switches her residency from general surgery to OB-GYN
Adopts Luna as a single mom

name: Stephanie Edwards
bio: Smart, driven resident of the post-original generation. Born with sickle cell anemia, which she'd hidden most of her life. Briefly dated Jackson; left at the (literal) altar of someone else's wedding. Walked away from Grey Sloan in 2017 after being severely burned in an explosion caused by a violent patient.

soloEvents.label: Joins Grey Sloan as an intern
Severely burned saving a child during a violent patient's explosion; leaves the hospital to travel

name: Andrew DeLuca
bio: Italian, charming, son of a brilliant but bipolar surgeon (Vincenzo) and brother to OB Carina. Dated Meredith. Spiraled into a manic episode himself in 2020. Stabbed to death in 2021 on a Seattle train platform after chasing down a human-trafficker.

soloEvents.label: Joins Grey Sloan as an intern
Beaten nearly to death by Alex Karev after Karev finds him in bed with Jo (it wasn't what it looked like)
Manic episode while uncovering a human-trafficking ring; later diagnosed with bipolar disorder like his father
Stabbed to death on a train platform by Opal, the trafficker he'd been pursuing

name: Carina DeLuca
bio: Andrew's older sister. OB-GYN/researcher who specialized in studying female orgasm and IVF. Eventually wed firefighter Maya Bishop (Station 19); they have a daughter Liesl. Stayed at Grey Sloan in a recurring capacity after S19 ended.
note: Splits time with Station 19, where she's a main cast member and Maya Bishop's wife. Grey's treats her as recurring.

soloEvents.label: Arrives at Grey Sloan from Italy to be with her brother
Andrew is stabbed to death; Carina is briefly the only DeLuca left in Seattle

name: Atticus 'Link' Lincoln
bio: Cancer-survivor-turned-orthopedic-surgeon. Sunny, goofy, surprisingly grounded. Long relationship with Amelia (one son, Scout) ended at his attempted proposal; rebounded with Jo Wilson and they had their second-chance baby in 2024.

soloEvents.label: Arrives at Grey Sloan from Boston as the new head of ortho
Welcomes son Scout with Amelia
Amelia rejects his proposal; they split
Welcomes son Charlie with Jo Wilson

name: Levi Schmitt
bio: Glasses. The clumsy intern who dropped a phone into a patient's open body cavity (S14), came out to his mother on a freeway in S15, and matured into a real surgeon. Long, complicated relationship with Nico Kim. Briefly left Grey Sloan in 2022 to find himself; returned. Departed for good in 2024.

soloEvents.label: Joins Grey Sloan as an intern; nickname 'Glasses' from Meredith sticks
Comes out to his mother while stuck in highway traffic
Leaves Grey Sloan permanently

name: Nico Kim
bio: Confident, openly gay ortho fellow who became Levi Schmitt's first relationship. On-again-off-again throughout the late 2010s. Left Grey Sloan in the early 2020s.

name: Nathan Riggs
bio: Owen Hunt's former best friend; engaged to Owen's sister Megan in Iraq, where she was presumed killed. Joined Grey Sloan in 2016 with Owen openly hating him. Briefly with Meredith. Left in 2018 to be with the (alive) Megan and their son Farouk in L.A.

soloEvents.label: Arrives at Grey Sloan; Owen punches him on sight
Reunited with Megan, presumed dead for a decade
Leaves Seattle to raise their son Farouk in Los Angeles with Megan

name: Tom Koracick
bio: Derek Shepherd's old neurosurgery mentor. Arrogant, witty, scarred by the death of his young son David from medulloblastoma. Briefly Chief of Surgery during the COVID/Bailey-leave gap. Affair with Teddy that exploded her near-wedding to Owen. Left Grey Sloan in 2021 after losing Jackson's plastics-fellowship buyout drama.

soloEvents.label: Brought in to consult on Amelia's brain tumor
Named interim Chief of Surgery
Leaves Grey Sloan after Jackson buys him out

name: Cormac Hayes
bio: Widower Irish pediatric surgeon with two teenage sons. Briefly flirted with Meredith but never quite landed. Returned to Ireland in 2021 to take a permanent job and raise his boys.

soloEvents.label: Arrives at Grey Sloan from Boston via Dublin
Returns permanently to Ireland with his sons

name: Winston Ndugu
bio: Sweet, gifted cardio fellow who fell for Maggie Pierce while she was at a conference. Followed her to Seattle. Married her in 2021; divorced her in 2023 after she took a job in Chicago without him. Has a complicated brother (Wendell) who manipulates him.

soloEvents.label: Begins long-distance relationship with Maggie over Zoom during COVID
Marries Maggie at Meredith's house
Maggie files for divorce after their careers diverge

name: Nick Marsh
bio: Brilliant Minnesota transplant surgeon who first met Meredith in 2017 as a patient (she saved his life). Re-met her in 2021 when she went to consult; they fell in love. Now her partner — splits time between Boston, Seattle, and Rochester.

soloEvents.label: Operated on by Meredith for a near-fatal blood clot; one-night stand in Minnesota
Meredith re-meets him when consulting at the Mayo Clinic

name: Simone Griffith
bio: Grew up across the street from Grey Sloan; her grandmother died of a misdiagnosis there. Joined the residency program anyway to fix what felt broken. Engaged to longtime boyfriend Trey, jilted him at the altar for Lucas Adams.

soloEvents.label: Joins Grey Sloan as part of the new intern class
Jilts Trey at the altar to pursue Lucas Adams

name: Lucas Adams
bio: Nico's nephew — Derek and Amelia's youngest sister Kathleen Shepherd's son. A late-bloomer who failed medical school once. Joined Grey Sloan in 2022 with Amelia warily watching. In an on-and-off relationship with Simone Griffith.

soloEvents.label: Joins Grey Sloan as an intern under his aunt Amelia's watchful gaze

name: Mika Yasuda
bio: Wisecracking, financially strapped intern who works second jobs (delivery, etc.) to support her family. Grew close to Levi Schmitt as a confidant.

soloEvents.label: Joins Grey Sloan as an intern

name: Benson 'Blue' Kwan
bio: Highly competitive intern with a complicated past (a divorced wife, Sloane, who ended up working in the same OR). On-and-off with Jules Millin.

soloEvents.label: Joins Grey Sloan as an intern, immediately gunning for top of the class

name: Jules Millin
bio: Brash, sharp-tongued intern from a complicated family. On-and-off with Blue Kwan.

soloEvents.label: Joins Grey Sloan as an intern

name: Ellis Grey
bio: Twice-winner of the Harper Avery. Meredith's mother. Brilliant, withholding, and dying of early-onset Alzheimer's that frequently lifted to expose how disappointed she was in her daughter. Had a long affair with Richard Webber. Died in 2007 of heart failure, briefly lucid at the end.

soloEvents.label: Living in a long-term-care facility with advanced Alzheimer's
Has a brief 'lucid' window during a code blue; dies of heart failure that same day

name: Thatcher Grey
bio: Meredith's father, who left Ellis when Meredith was five. Re-married Susan, fathered Lexie and Molly. Alcoholic; Lexie's mother Susan's death sent him into relapse. Reconciled with Lexie and (eventually) Meredith. Died of cancer in 2018.

soloEvents.label: Susan dies of complications from a hiccup-induced hospitalization; he relapses
Hits Lexie in a drunken rage at the hospital
Dies of cancer; Meredith reconciles with him in his final days

name: Susan Grey
bio: Thatcher's second wife, Lexie and Molly's mother. Warm, motherly, briefly tried to mother Meredith. Died of toxic shock from a chronic hiccup-related hospital admission in 2007 — a death Thatcher blamed Meredith for.

soloEvents.label: Dies of TSS during what should have been a routine surgical admission

name: Adele Webber
bio: Richard's longtime wife. Knew about his affair with Ellis Grey; forgave him slowly. Diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's. Died in 2013 of a heart attack on the same day Bailey successfully performed a brand-new Alzheimer's trial procedure on her.

soloEvents.label: Diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's
Dies of cardiac arrest hours after Bailey's groundbreaking surgery

name: Denny Duquette
bio: Charming heart-failure patient who waited months at Seattle Grace for a transplant. Fell in love with Izzie. Their plan: she cut his LVAD wire to bump him up the donor list. He got the heart, recovered, proposed — and died of a stroke hours later. Came back as a vivid hallucination during Izzie's own cancer treatment in S5.

soloEvents.label: Receives a heart transplant; proposes to Izzie; dies of a stroke that same evening
Appears to Izzie as a hallucination during her own cancer treatment

name: Finn Dandridge
bio: 'McVet.' Meredith's dog's veterinarian. Briefly Derek's rival for Meredith in S2/3. Lost.

name: Henry Burton
bio: Patient Teddy met through Bailey. Married Teddy purely to get insurance for his VHL treatment — and they fell in love anyway. Died on the table in 2012 during what should have been a routine surgery; Teddy was operating on someone else, told she was working on a different patient until after.

soloEvents.label: Marries Teddy to get insurance for his Von Hippel-Lindau syndrome
Dies during surgery; Cristina is forced to break the news mid-procedure

name: Tucker Jones
bio: Bailey's first husband; father of Tuck Jr. Critically injured in a car accident during the S3 ferry-boat episode. The marriage didn't survive Bailey's career; they divorced amicably in 2010.

soloEvents.label: Critically injured in a car accident on the same day Tuck is born
Finalizes divorce from Bailey

name: Eli Lloyd
bio: Confident nurse Bailey dated between Tucker and Ben. Pushed Bailey to date him openly despite her hangups about dating a nurse.

name: Matthew Taylor
bio: Devout, sweet paramedic April Kepner first dated and then jilted at the altar. Married someone else (Karin), widowed her in childbirth in 2018, then reunited with April and moved with her into trauma fieldwork.

soloEvents.label: Left at the altar by April, who runs off and marries Jackson
Wife Karin dies in childbirth; reunites with April

name: Ava / Rebecca Pope
bio: Pulled from the ferry-boat wreckage by Alex, suffering amnesia; he named her 'Ava.' Her real name was Rebecca Pope and she was pregnant and married. Diagnosed with borderline personality disorder; faked a pregnancy with Alex. Last seen being involuntarily committed.

soloEvents.label: Pulled from the ferry-boat wreckage by Alex with no memory of who she is
Diagnosed with borderline personality disorder; involuntarily committed

name: Penny Blake
bio: The resident who was treating Derek the night he died — and who Meredith met months later at Maggie's dinner party not realizing the connection. Callie's girlfriend; moved with her (and Sofia) to New York in 2016.

soloEvents.label: Revealed to Meredith as 'the doctor who killed Derek'
Wins the Preminger Grant and moves with Callie to New York

name: Erica Hahn
bio: Took over cardio briefly after Burke. Callie's first relationship with a woman. Walked out of the hospital parking lot in S5 after a confrontation about Izzie's medical conduct and was never seen on screen again.

soloEvents.label: Walks out of Seattle Grace after the Denny-Izzie scandal; never returns

name: Megan Hunt
bio: Owen's sister. Army trauma surgeon, presumed dead in Iraq for ten years after her helicopter went down. Found alive and held captive in 2017. Reunited with her former fiancé Riggs in Seattle. Adopted a Syrian war orphan, Farouk; moved with Riggs to L.A. in 2018.

soloEvents.label: Helicopter goes down in Iraq; presumed dead
Found alive after a decade in captivity; brought to Grey Sloan to recover
Adopts Farouk; moves to LA with Riggs

name: Kai Bartley
bio: Non-binary Parkinson's researcher in Minnesota whom Amelia met (and fell for) on Meredith's research trips. The relationship ended over Amelia's desire for more kids that Kai didn't want.

soloEvents.label: Meets Amelia through Meredith's Parkinson's research project
Breaks up with Amelia over kids

name: Sadie Harris
bio: Meredith's wild-child friend from her year off in Europe ('Death'). Joined the new intern class in S5; failed the program and disappeared.

soloEvents.label: Joins Seattle Grace's intern class on Meredith's recommendation
Quits the program after the Chief discovers she lied her way in

name: Sam Bello
bio: Brilliant DACA-recipient resident DeLuca briefly dated. Forced to flee Seattle in 2018 to avoid deportation; took a fellowship in Switzerland (under, of all people, Cristina Yang).

soloEvents.label: Flees to Switzerland to avoid ICE deportation; takes a fellowship at Cristina Yang's institute

name: Shane Ross
bio: Cristina's chosen protégé from the new intern class. Cracked under pressure after his role in Heather's death; came back stronger. Followed Cristina to Zurich.

soloEvents.label: Sends Heather Brooks into the basement during the storm, where she's electrocuted
Follows Cristina to her Zurich institute

name: Heather Brooks
bio: Cheerful, eager intern Derek nicknamed 'Mousey.' Electrocuted in a flooded hospital basement during a Seattle superstorm; never regained consciousness.

soloEvents.label: Electrocuted in the flooded basement during the superstorm; dies after surgery

name: Carolyn Shepherd
bio: Derek and Amelia's mother. Matriarch of five Shepherd siblings. Came to Meredith and Derek's wedding; later returned briefly after Derek's death.

name: Robert Avery
bio: Jackson's estranged biological father. Walked out on Catherine when Jackson was young. Jackson found him running a diner in Montana.

name: Harper Avery
bio: Catherine's father-in-law, Jackson's grandfather. Founder of the Harper Avery Foundation. Posthumously exposed in 2018 as a serial sexual harasser, leading to the Foundation's rebrand as the Catherine Fox Foundation.

soloEvents.label: Posthumously revealed as a serial sexual harasser; the Foundation he founded is renamed

name: Sloan Riley
bio: Mark Sloan's teenage daughter from a high-school relationship. Showed up pregnant on his doorstep in S6. Stayed with Mark and Lexie briefly; gave the baby up for adoption; left.

soloEvents.label: Gives birth to a son; gives him up for adoption and leaves Seattle

members.name: Zola Grey-Shepherd
members.note: Adopted from Malawi as an orphaned NICU patient at Seattle Grace

members.name: Bailey Grey-Shepherd
members.note: Born during a citywide superstorm blackout; named for Miranda Bailey

members.name: Ellis Grey-Shepherd

name: Wes Bryant
bio: Eager, irrepressible new intern who joined Grey Sloan in S22. Talked his way into properly dating Simone Griffith by the finale, even though her heart was still tangled up with Lucas Adams.

soloEvents.label: Joins Grey Sloan as part of the next intern class
Asks Simone out 'properly' the night of the bridge collapse

name: Toni Wright
bio: Plastic surgeon who joined Grey Sloan in S22 while still married (to Celine, with a young son Zach). Fell into a brief affair with Amelia Shepherd that imploded the night Toni decided to leave her marriage — only to find Cass Beckman waiting at Amelia's.

soloEvents.label: Tells her wife Celine she wants out of their marriage to pursue Amelia

name: Cass Beckman
bio: Trauma surgeon at Seattle Presbyterian. Married to David Beckman (also a surgeon) in an open marriage. Got pulled into the Grey Sloan orbit in S21 when a dinner introduction to Owen and Teddy turned into a multi-episode flirtation, then a full romance with Teddy after Owen and Teddy opened their own marriage. By the S22 finale, with Teddy choosing Owen and Paris, Cass had already moved on — found waiting on Amelia Shepherd's couch the night Toni Wright came to commit.

soloEvents.label: First crosses paths with Owen and Teddy at a dinner where the husbands get paged away ('Night Moves', S21)
Stranded at Grey Sloan during the Royer Bridge collapse; works the trauma bay alongside the staff
